title: fix(signal): honor paragraph chunking for formatted messages
body:
Closes #176239

## What Problem This Solves

Formatted Signal sends ignore the existing newline chunk mode and pack paragraphs purely by length. The formatted adapter now resolves the account-aware chunk mode and groups parsed paragraphs outside code spans before using the existing rendered-size splitter. This preserves internal code blank lines, styles, and length-mode behavior. Thanks to @yetval for reporting and @tianhaotian for the fix; contributor commits are preserved.

## Evidence

Built main d85fcb29bec40d33dc6055fe4144cbf468b8848c and built candidate d1dd239c335e2f13e07efd5d83a1e9c35ab3837c in secretless Docker. The relevant baseline Signal owners are unchanged on main d1b8bccb9d5. Ran a real Gateway and shipped `openclaw agent --deliver --reply-channel signal` with a scripted multi-paragraph model response. Only the model HTTP endpoint and signal-cli JSON-RPC server are mocks; Gateway, agent turn, outbound delivery, formatting and transport client ran normally.

Observed twice on main with newline mode and once with length mode: two Signal sends, the first containing the intro plus two list items. Observed twice on candidate with newline mode: three sends, intro alone, three list items, final list item. Candidate length-mode control retains the original two sends.

Captured candidate messages:

```text
Intro here.

[separate Signal message]
• item one aaaa
• item two bbbb
• item three cc

[separate Signal message]
• item four dddd
```

Additional shipped `message send` control with a six-character limit preserved code text as `aaa` + two internal newlines + `bbb`; captured chunks were `aaa` + two newlines + `b`, then `bb`, with chunk-local MONOSPACE ranges. Intro retained BOLD and End retained ITALIC.

Focused tests: 60 passed across Signal core, Signal format and shared render-aware chunking. The candidate core regression file on baseline fails four cases (paragraph grouping, rendered URL sizing, code/style boundaries, account chunk-mode selection); 38 pass. Changed-file Oxfmt and Oxlint pass. No real phone delivery was claimed or exercised.

Simplification reuses parsed IR and the existing rendered-size owner, without SDK expansion. Production +62/-8 (net +54), tests +89/-0. Remaining growth is needed to recognize paragraph boundaries outside code spans and measure rendered link lengths; regressions cover the distinct boundaries and precedence. Existing documentation already promises newline paragraph chunking and remains unchanged.

Merge danger: two-way door; revert fully restores previous chunk boundaries without state migration. Blast radius is formatted Signal sends using newline mode; length mode and media captions retain their existing path.
